newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine bonds rise on anticipation of U.S. jobs.
newsitem.headline: Argentine bonds rise on anticipation of U.S. jobs.

text.p: Argentine bonds were higher late morning Thursday as the market rose in anticipation of a market-friendly U.S. jobless report Friday.
"The market is slightly cautious but has a very firm underlying tone," said a trader at a local bank.
Argentina's FRB Brady bond due 2005 was up 1/8 at 93-3/8 while the dollar-denominated Bocon Previsional 2 due 2001 was up $0.10 at 123.65.
Another trader said players were position squaring ahead of the jobless report release.
If Friday's report is positive for the market, many of the investors who have remained on the sidelines in recent months preferring to hold cash, could enter the market, added the second trader.
"There is a lot of cash out there - they have to enter the market at some stage," he said, referring to local pension funds and overseas investors.
